# George Medal (Russian Empire)

The George Medal () was a medal of the Russian Empire issued for gallantry doring peace time and war time to  lower ranks (privates and non-commissioned officers). It could also be issued to civilians for combat gallantry, as well as to medical personnel. It had four degrees. It was estavlished on August 10, 1913.
The recipiend of all four classes was called "full George cavalier".
